text:
julia: Heads-up 1: Polaris preview lab sprint confirmed. NDA signed last week, Polaris rack reserved for 1 week starting 2026-04-05. Scope: smoke + perf sweep + telemetry hook for quality feedback and a minimal marketplace artifact. We need owners for: access provisioning, bench image, telemetry contract, legal handback, and a marketing embargo window. Quick sync here to assign.

nate: I can own the bench image + harness. Will build on image tag: rwinf-2026-preview-1. Need Polaris to share their PCIe driver build id if we are validating perf claims.

rafa: I'll own test vectors and reporting. Proposed matrix: seq lengths [64,256,1024], precisions [fp16,int8], throughput targets (in tokens/sec) per model size. Also track p99 and p999 latencies.

anya: Legal: NDA covers aggregated telemetry. We need Polaris to sign the "data handback + scrub" clause before we enable trace-level collection. Also require a short redaction rule for any user-visible outputs.

julia: Copy. @polaris-ops can you confirm signing the handback?

polaris-ops: emma@polaris.ai here. We'll sign the handback clause by Tue 2026-03-31. PCIe driver build: polaris-driver-4.2.0-rc3. We'll provide a small test runtime if you prefer, but happy to run your harness as well.

infra-bot: snapshot created: rwinf-2026-preview-1 by infra-team.

nate: Great. I'll use rwinf-2026-preview-1 as the baseline. Sharing draft quick command for Polaris to run locally and in our lab:
```
python3 bin/run_sprint.py --model polaris-proto-XL --image rwinf-2026-preview-1 --seq 1024 --precision fp16 --iters 20 --telemetry-url https://telemetry.redwood/sprint/collect --seed 42
```

rafa: Also adding a short CSV output spec so we can ingest into the dashboard: columns = [model, seq, precision, gpu_mem_gb, avg_tps, p99_ms, p999_ms, driver_id, image_tag]

maria: I can handle SSH key onboarding + user mapping. @nate send me the list of usernames from Polaris and I'll add them to the access list. Reminder: we currently rotate lab keys every 30 days.

anya: I'll post the handback appendix draft in this thread tomorrow morning. Will include deletion window (30 days) and allowed aggregated metrics.

julia: Marketing note: biz wants a one-paragraph co-announcement embargo plan. Target: announcement no sooner than 10 business days after sprint completes. That gives us 3 days for perf signoff. Can we plan for that?

rafa: Yes, we'll aim for reproducible runs and a short perf card. Also will include a short appendix on measurement variance.

polaris-ops: One ask: Polaris would like a small reproducibility checklist so our lab runs match yours. Can you share config knobs we must fix?

julia: Good call. We'll include: exact image tag, driver id, CUDA/cuDNN versions, affinity settings, batch sizes, random seed, input corpus. @rafa please add to runbook.

infra-bot: maintenance notice: lab firmware update scheduled 2026-04-07 03:00-03:30 UTC. Avoid long end-to-end runs then.

nate: Noted. I'll schedule long sweeps outside that window. Short smoke runs okay during.

maria: Keys onboarding ETA: 2026-04-01 EOD.

anya: Handback appendix ETA: 2026-03-31 noon.

rafa: I'll post the reporting template and CSV spec by 2026-04-01.

julia: Action items recap: 1) @nate bench image + harness (rwinf-2026-preview-1) due Mon 2026-04-01; 2) @maria keys onboarding due 2026-04-01 EOD; 3) @anya handback appendix due Tue 2026-03-31; 4) @rafa reporting & reproducibility checklist by 2026-04-01. Polaris contact: emma@polaris.ai (cced).

polaris-ops: confirmed on timeline. We'll prepare driver logs and basic telemetry endpoint credentials for your collector.

julia: Awesome. I'll schedule a 20m sync Fri 2026-03-28 9am PT to walk through runbook draft. Post short updates here so we can keep everything centralized. :rocket:
